comment: The four group labels on the panel read 1-4, 5-8, 9-12 and 12-16; the last is wrong. Polygate.cpp:81-84 lays the buttons out as channels 1-4 and 5-8 down the left column and 9-12 and 13-16 down the right, and the tooltips name them Channel 13 to Channel 16, so the group under the 12-16 label is channels 13 to 16.
